name: entry-prism
rationale: Frozen baseline traces repeatedly reject entries solely because the first projected blocker lies wholly above the player or below the support band. Such evidence motivates a height-aware proof, not unconditional projection bypass.
hypothesis: A continuous source-triangle prism test from original support seam to an actual exterior approach start can safely admit overhang/understructure cases while still rejecting sealed holes, source-support overlay, narrow passages and body obstructions. Same-mode historical acceptance runs first; only failures receive one bounded prism pass. Criteria, proposals, route/witness budgets, original navigator and locked scales are unchanged.
